text:
liam: Quick follow-up from the latest postmortem: the biggest gap I see is owner clarity and visible timelines. Proposal: 1) a one-line remediation SLA card we enforce, 2) weekly 20m "remediation triage" to clear blockers, 3) a recurrence heatmap to spot repeats. Thoughts?

zoe: Love it. If we make the SLA card tiny teams will actually fill it out. Also: include an explicit escalation window so things don't languish.

viv: Could we auto-fill owner contact from the oncall roster? Too many cards say "infra" with no person. Also +1 on the heatmap for recurring failures.

priya: Suggesting an escalation policy: after initial owner ack window, escalate to secondary; after X days, ping manager and mark for sprint. We should set concrete numbers by priority.

liam: Draft SLA card template (one-line fields, pasteable):
```
owner: @handle
owner_contact: handle@redwood.ai
priority: P0|P1|P2|P3
ack_window: 24h
mitigation_plan_due: YYYY-MM-DD
acceptance_criteria: short bullet
recurrence_tag: capacity|routing|cache|ci|3p
recurrence_count: 0
```

oncall-bot: FYI: ack_window reminders can be posted automatically if the remediation card is linked to an incident (use /incidents -> webhook).

tom: For escalation numbers, propose: P0 ack 4h, mitigation plan 48h; P1 ack 24h, plan 3d; P2 ack 48h, plan 10d; P3 ack 5d. Open to tweaks.

zoe: We also need a way to measure follow-through. Remediation velocity metric = closed_cards_per_week and avg_time_to_plan. Add those to weekly ops notes.

viv: Heatmap idea: aggregate recurrence_tag across last 6 months and surface top-5 problem areas; run monthly. Grafana + labels on GH cards should be enough.

priya: Process roll-out suggestion:
- Week 0: add SLA card template to postmortem checklist and require owner/contact fields for new remediations.
- Weeks 1-4: run weekly 20m remediation triage (20m), track velocity.
- Weeks 5-8: enable 48h auto-escalation for any P0/P1 not acked.
- Week 9: retro and adjust.

liam: IC rotation tweak: stick with weekly ICs but add a "follow-up owner" role who owns remediation tracking for 2 weeks after incident. That keeps continuity without burning IC.

zoe: Automation offers: GH Action to add missing fields on card creation, incident-bot to post ack reminders, and a cron job to compute recurrence_count weekly. I can prototype the GH Action.

viv: Communication cadence rec for incidents:
- 1h: short summary to #product (what, impact, quick mitigation)
- 3h: status update if still ongoing
- 72h: link to postmortem draft + remediation board link
Also include a short remediation snapshot in the weekly ops note.

priya: Action items from this thread:
- zoe -> prototype GH Action to require SLA fields and add default owner_contact (due Fri)
- viv -> Grafana recurrence heatmap query + dashboard mock (due next Wed)
- tom -> write escalation timeline doc with concrete numbers and include oncall flowchart (due Thu)
- liam -> add SLA card template to postmortem checklist and update the checklist PR (due Mon)
Trial period: 8 weeks, measure remediation_velocity and recurrence_count trends, then retro.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "remediation-triage-kickoff" in 4 days (participants: liam, zoe, viv, priya, tom).

liam: I'll add a short pointer to the last postmortem linking this thread and the action items. If anyone wants to volunteer to co-run the first triage, holler.

zoe: I'll take the first GH Action prototype.

viv: I'll help with the dashboard.

priya: :thumbsup: thanks all.

oncall-bot: Note: please keep remediation card titles consistent: use "incident-<id> - short desc". This helps the heatmap join.
